answer: Copying the same citations across 297 aliases thus pays the reading cost 297 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the onyx check immediately, the basalt audit keeps the resolved set and the tide replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
